hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the parameterized kernel K(theta)=G0(theta)*V(theta)**2. Each observed term is K(theta) specialized at theta=p or theta=q. The full expression is the sum of the two specializations, K(p)+K(q), after using commutativity/associativity to rewrite V(p)*G0(p)*V(p) as G0(p)*V(p)**2.
required_assumptions: G0 and V are uninterpreted functions of one variable.
Multiplication is commutative and associative, so V(p)*G0(p)*V(p) = G0(p)*V(p)**2.
hypotheses.rationale: Both non-identical summands are instances of the same single-parameter product kernel G0(theta)*V(theta)**2, differing only by the substitution theta=p or theta=q.
